description:
Creates a copy-on-write clone of a PostgreSQL instance: it has the source's data from the moment of branching, and the two diverge independently afterwards.

THIS COSTS MONEY — a branch is billed hourly like any instance: on its plan, and on what it writes itself above that plan's included storage at €0.15/GB/month, while it is a branch. Once promoted, it is billed on its full size. Pick a smaller plan than the source when the branch is for a test.

Takes about a minute: the clone itself is instant, but a second PostgreSQL has to start. Poll get_instance until status is "active". Branching is refused on instances not using branch-capable storage.

expires_in_days.description: Days before the branch is deleted automatically. Defaults to 7.

id.description: Instance id, as returned by list_instances

tier.description: Plan for the branch, from list_plans. Defaults to the source's.

name: create_branch
title: Branch a PostgreSQL database
